answer.headline: Revenue grew due to overall session increases, though a shift toward new visitors created a drag on conversion behavior.
explanation: Revenue increased compared to the previous week, driven largely by a surge in overall sessions.
However, a distinct mix shift occurred as new users grew at a much faster rate than the rest of the site.
New visitors exhibited lower conversion rates and product-view rates compared to returning visitors, creating a drag on the metric.
answer.next_step: Review recent acquisition campaigns to see if incoming new visitor traffic has lower purchase intent.
